meta.scope: frontend/components/simulations: class1-class5, maths, loose subject folders (bio/chem/cs/evs/geo/physics if non-empty) + root-level shared widgets. EXCLUDED: c6_12* (owned by c6_12 mapper), three/, _* archive/backup folders.
meta.topicKeyScheme: g{class}.{slug} = class-band sim (g1..g5); m0.{slug} = loose maths/ simple-machine sims (unpinned class); infra.{slug} = shared root widget, not a topic sim
verdictRules: SUPERSEDED: same-class-band sims_v2 entry covers the topic with verdict PERFECT/GOOD
KEEP-MASTER: same-class-band v2 entry exists but is THIN/BROKEN, or GOOD with off-topic/degenerate generator issues while legacy is a >=600-line bespoke component
KEEP-UNIQUE: no same-class-band v2 coverage (or only cross-class adjacency, which never supersedes)
meta.deterministic: no timestamps; v2QualitySha256 pins the dedupe reference; re-run byte-identical while inputs unchanged
